summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all nine paragraphs of the selected Greek source. No concrete fidelity defects were identified. Both preserve the crown, clothing and seal distinctions; the bracketed editorial supplement [white]; repeated careful inspection; the conditional altar warning; speaker attribution; planting and moisture conditions; possible failure and the no-negligence negation; and the distinction between the creator’s desire for all branch recipients to live and the shepherd’s hope for the greater part. The simplified edition’s sentence divisions do not materially change these claims. The notes retain the working readings while disclosing alternatives and are compatible with the supplied bounded reports. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure evidence, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, independent verification of the cited editions, or exhaustive collation.
